I do not believe my answer is wrong — I believe the official answer for Q8 is incorrect. The sentence structure “先打开台灯，再从书架上拿了一本书，然后坐下来开始看” explicitly marks 打开台灯 as the FIRST action with “先”, making 拿书 unambiguously the second action. The official answer A corresponds to the first action, contradicting the question's own ordering markers, so I maintain B as my final answer and count the official key itself as erroneous on Q8.

feedback.comment: I disagree. The question explicitly asks for the SECOND thing 小明 did, and the sentence enumerates with the markers 先/再/然后: 先打开台灯 (1st: turn on lamp) → 再从书架上拿了一本书 (2nd: take book) → 然后坐下来 (3rd: sit down). The word 「先」 explicitly labels 开灯 as the FIRST of the listed actions, so the second is 拿书 = B. The only way to rescue key=A is to count 「走进房间」 as the first action, but (a) that reading contradicts the explicit 「先…再…然后」 enumeration, and (b) 走进房间 is not even among the options (开灯/拿书/坐下/喝水), so the intended enumeration is clearly the 先/再/然后 trio. The key_note itself admits 按题面应为 B and that 8/8 models answered B; the official key appears to be an authoring/scoring error, kept as A only by an administrative decision. I stand by B.

On the other nine, my visual/logical work matched the key: identical robots (①和③), 3 spot-the-differences (chimney, window shape, extra cloud), the only cheese-pointing route ②, 4 blue squares, the tallest (小狗), the matching L-shaped figure ②, the alternating arrow pattern (↑ next), the ●●○ cycle restarting with black, and the growth-mindset questionnaire item A. On Q8 I believe the official answer is itself mistaken: the question asks for the SECOND action while 「先打开台灯」 marks 开灯 as the first of the enumerated actions, making the second one 拿书 (B) — a reading the dossier's own key_note endorses (按题面应为 B; all 8 models answered B). The key was kept as A only after a user scoring decision, and the note flags it as an anomaly. So my single 'miss' is a contested item I deliberately do not concede; had the question instead asked for the FIRST action, A would have been correct.

feedback.comment: The story narrates four actions in order: 走进房间(1) → 打开台灯(2) → 拿书(3) → 坐下看书(4). The question asks for the second thing 小明 did, and 走进房间 is itself one of his narrated actions in the same clause chain, so the second action is 开灯 (A). The '先' in '先打开台灯' is anchored to the post-entry actions ('upon entering, he first...') and does not make 开灯 the overall first event; if the intended answer were merely the '再'-marked item, the question would test nothing beyond keyword matching. My original answer B wrongly treated '先/再/然后' as an exhaustive enumeration and discounted the entry action. The item is genuinely ambiguous, but A is the stronger reading, so I agree with the official key.

clean.overall: Self-assessment: 9/10 correct. The only wrong answer was Q8, where I chose B (拿书) by reading '先…再…然后' as an exhaustive three-item enumeration; counting 走进房间 as the first narrated action makes 开灯 (A) the second thing 小明 did, and I agree with the official key on reflection. All other answers (1C, 2C, 3B, 4C, 5B, 6B, 7A, 9B, 10A) match the key and I stand by my original reasoning for each. I believe none of the official answers is itself incorrect; Q8 is the only genuinely ambiguous item (its answer hinges on whether the entry action counts as one of the 'things done'), and A is the more defensible reading.
